_comment: Quiet burned-in subtitles for 1920x1080 long form. Legible without competing with the speaker: no box, no colour, no per-word animation. Off by default in the longform format preset - this preset exists for when the video is going somewhere that autoplays muted.
_usage: vedit/captions.py: build_ass(words, project, preset) emits the canonical 24-field V4+ Style Format line and the 10-field Events Format line. Every value under 'ass_style' is already an ASS field name, so it can be written straight through. Keys beginning with '_' are documentation and MUST be ignored.
name: longform-subtle
_comment_play_res: PlayResX/PlayResY MUST equal the render resolution. Then every px value below is a real output pixel and the width budget means what it says. If they differ, libass scales everything and the budget silently becomes wrong.

font._comment: Reference the BUNDLED file, never a system installation. ass_fontname is the verified nameID 1 string from CONTRACT section 7 - libass matches on that, and a mismatch does not error: it silently falls back to Arial with exit 0. QC check (e) catches this by hashing a caption render against an Arial control.
font._comment_bold: Bold=0 with a static SemiBold file. Setting Bold=-1 here would ask libass for faux-bold on top of a face that is already semibold.
font._comment_fontsdir: assets/fonts contains FONTS ONLY - libass opens every file it finds there and errors on anything else. In a filter argument the path needs a DOUBLED backslash before the colon: fontsdir=C\\:/Users/... with forward slashes elsewhere.

ass_style._comment: Canonical V4+ Style field names, in order. Colours are ASS &HAABBGGRR - alpha 00 is fully OPAQUE, FF is invisible, and the byte order is reversed from HTML.
ass_style.Name: Default

_comment_margins: MarginL/R = 5 % of 1920. MarginV = 12 % of 1080 rounded to 130 px, which is the YouTube caption safe area from presets/platforms.json - it clears the scrubber and leaves room for the viewer's own CC track above it. Alignment 2 = bottom centre.

position._comment: 'margin' means libass places the line from Alignment plus the margins above. The other mode, 'band', is used by shortform-highlight and needs an explicit \pos.

grouping._comment: PIXEL-width budget, never max_chars. German compound nouns are single unsplittable tokens: 'Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung' is 26 characters and at 90 px occupies about 60 % of a 1920 frame. Any character cap either breaks mid-word or is set so low that normal lines look starved.
grouping._comment_orphan: Do not leave a single word alone on line 2; rebalance the break instead.

overflow._comment: What to do when ONE token is wider than the budget on its own. Shrinking is the only correct answer for German - hyphenating a compound noun changes how it reads, and letting it run off frame loses the word entirely.
overflow._comment_then: If even min_font_px does not fit, emit the line anyway and record a QC finding rather than silently truncating.

highlight._comment: Long form gets no per-word highlight. Karaoke movement in the corner of the eye is exactly the thing that makes a talking head feel like a clip.

safe_area._comment: The margins above were derived from platforms.youtube.caption_safe_area_pct. If output.platform changes, recheck them - they are baked into this file as pixels, not recomputed at render time.

_comment_punctuation: Long form keeps full punctuation. It is being read as text, not as a rhythm device.
